receipts.purpose: independent integration of the two-loop SM RGE (Buttazzo 2013 App. B, y_b=y_tau=0) with thresholds Eqs.(55),(57)-(60); Delta_lambda from Eq.(61e) over 5 calibration inputs at mu=1.2209e19 GeV; couplings at mu_b=Mbar_P/722 for (172.6,0.1180,125.13,80.3692); Coulomb-mode infinite-volume MS-bar closed form vs subtracted numerical integral; scalar limit of the same subtraction scheme
receipts.code_summary: beta[{G1,G2,G3,Yt,l}] in d/d ln mu^2 (GUT g1); NDSolveValue WorkingPrecision 25, PrecisionGoal 15; lam61e = -0.0143 - 0.0066 (Mt-173.34) + 0.0018 (as-0.1184)/0.0007 + 0.0029 (Mh-125.15); Ifin = NIntegrate[k (Sqrt[(k^2+A)(k^2+B)] - k^2 - (A+B)/2 + (A-B)^2/(8 (k^2+M^2))), {k,0,Infinity}] with A=7/10, B=23/10, M=13/10; ECnum = Ifin/(4 Pi^2) - (A-B)^2/(64 Pi^2)(Log[1/M^2] + 2 - 2 Log[2]); ECcl = ((A+B)^2 - 2(A+B)Sqrt[A B] + (A-B)^2 (Log[(Sqrt[A]+Sqrt[B])^2] - 5/2))/(64 Pi^2); scalar: A=m2=17/10, B=0 vs m2^2 (Log[m2]-3/2)/(64 Pi^2)
